title: myriophyllum humile f. capillaceum
intro: Myriophyllum humile f. capillaceum, commonly known as dwarf water-milfoil, is a submerged aquatic plant found in freshwater environments. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myriophyllum humile f. capillaceum include wound healing, anti-inflammatory responses, and the inhibition of certain bacterial and fungal infections. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
